post.summary: Cancel the shopper's own unpaid order and release its stock, once. Repeating is harmless. An opened checkout is first closed by what the payment provider says (only failed tries: failed; no payment: expired). An order whose payment is captured, authorized or still in progress is left pending (awaiting_payment_outcome); another shopper's order is 404; 502 when the provider cannot be asked

The same Idempotency-Key, another tab or a retry returns the same attempt and checkout. Sandbox only; 503 when payments are off

outcome.description: From our records only: paid once the provider has confirmed it, never because the browser said so

verified.description: The provider signed this return for the checkout we opened (an unsigned or tampered return is a 400)

post.summary: Report what the payment provider's checkout handed the browser. An untrusted signal: its shape and the provider's signature are checked against the checkout we opened (a tampered return is a 400), nothing is recorded, and the order is never marked paid by it. The answer is our own record of the order and its payment

parameters.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the webhook secret

post.summary: Razorpay's webhook. Verified before anything is read: the signature over the exact raw body with the webhook secret, the event id, then the event type and its entity (INR only). Anything that does not verify is a 400. Each event is kept once in the inbox before it is acknowledged; a duplicate changes nothing. Sandbox only; not yet acted on

info.title: Chaanavya API
info.description: Called only by the Chaanavya web host (shop and admin), server to server, with the x-chaanavya-internal-key header. Sign-in endpoints are Better Auth's, under /api/auth, and are not listed here.
